home.practice_tractor_blurb: Swap loot up and down to line up three of a kind and beam it aboard. Lift sealed caches to the hatch, and fire beacons through them.
tractor.title: Tractor
tractor.how_to: Swap a piece with the one above or below it. Three or more of one kind in a row or a column are beamed aboard: a run of n scores 5 times n times n. Everything below rises to close the gap, and new loot drifts in at the bottom. Sealed caches cannot be swapped: clear what is above one and it rises, and a cache that reaches the top row is hauled aboard. Caches hauled in one swap count together, so two at once are worth four times one.
tractor.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the pair of cells the cursor holds. Space or enter swaps them.
tractor.cascade_note: When what rises makes new runs, they go too, each wave worth more than the last, up to double.
tractor.beacon_note: A beacon matches as its kind. In a run it fires: a cross sweeps its row and column, a saltire both its diagonals. Every piece on those lines comes aboard, a beacon swept fires in turn, and a cache on those lines is hauled at once.
tractor.stage.runs_intro: Swap a piece with the one above or below it to line up three of a kind. Longer runs are worth far more.
tractor.stage.caches_intro: Sealed caches rise as you clear what is above them. Bring two to the top in one swap for four times the haul.
tractor.stage.full_intro: Beacons drift in. Line your caches up and fire one through them.
tractor.hint_note: Practice rounds show a swap worth making when you pause.
tractor.legend_loot: Loot: five kinds, each its own shape.
tractor.legend_cache: Sealed cache. Cannot be swapped. Hauled at the top row or by a beacon: one is worth 150, two in one swap 600, three 1350.
tractor.legend_cross: Cross beacon. Matches as its kind; in a run it sweeps its row and column.
tractor.legend_saltire: Saltire beacon. Matches as its kind; in a run it sweeps both its diagonals.
tractor.legend_hatch: The line over the field is the hatch. A cache that rises to it is hauled aboard.
studio.preset.tractor_cache_rush: Cache rush: caches drift in often, up to five
studio.preset.tractor_beacon_rush: Beacon rush: one every two scoring swaps
studio.preset.tractor_flat_cascade: Flat cascades: every wave at 100 percent
studio.preset.tractor_wide_field: A wide field: eight by ten
